question: As of 2026-10-07, before November, how long do service tokens last?

claims.text: As of 2026-10-07, before November 2026, service tokens expire after sixty minutes.

supports.quote: Beginning 2026-11-01, service tokens expire after thirty minutes; before that date they expire after sixty minutes.

uncertainties: Synthesized from current authorized evidence; exact supporting quotes and a separate model review were checked. Model review can miss errors; verify important conclusions.
